name: Compute Cluster S06: Lookback Memory + Kleene Null Logic
description: Tests: valuewhen sparse access, isna-or-threshold Kleene pattern (TRUE OR NULL = TRUE), first-bar anchor trap.
source:
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)
ts = index().value

# --- Test 1: Basic valuewhen ---
big_up = ret > 0.02
last_big = valuewhen(big_up, close)

# --- Test 2: Kleene null logic (isna OR threshold) ---
# barssince returns NULL before any event. With Kleene OR:
# isna(NULL) = TRUE, TRUE OR NULL = TRUE → first event detected.
# Before the fix, TRUE OR NULL = NULL → first event silently dropped.
bars_gap = barssince(big_up) >> 1
first_or_gap = isna(bars_gap) or bars_gap >= 60
new_cluster = big_up and first_or_gap
cluster_price = where(new_cluster, close)
cluster_year = where(new_cluster, datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts))

# --- Test 3: cumulative First anchor (safe alternative to shifted-bool) ---
baseline = cumulative(close, agg=AggregationType.First)
ret_from_start = close / baseline - 1

# --- Outputs ---
xy_lines(title="Lookback Memory", category="S06 Memory", series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name="Last Big Up Close", color=Color.Blue)]), order=0)(ts, last_big)

xy_bars(mode=BarMode.labeled, agg=AggregationType.Last, title="Cluster Starts (Kleene Test)", category="S06 Memory", color_by_value=True, data_labels=True, order=1)(values=cluster_price, label=cluster_year)

xy_lines(title="Return from Start (Anchor Test)", category="S06 Memory", series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name="Cumulative Return", color=Color.Green)]), y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, order=2)(ts, ret_from_start)
